notes.title: The game is NOW avaiable!
notes.content: [p]Hey guys![/p][p]After months of work Knight Jump is finally finished! So lets go get it, tell friends and your favorite content creators and have fun with it! Try to beat it in 60 minutes :D[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for everything and see you soon![/p][p]ActiveDev aka Erik[/p]
